card.title: 238th REGIMENT
card.text: Deals double damage if you have 3 or fewer kredit slots.
card.flavorText: During WWII, the 238th Infantry Regiment was part of the 41st Division, an infantry formation of the Imperial Japanese Army. The division was raised in Utsunomiya in 1939 as a triangular division, with the 237th, 238th, and 239th Infantry Regiments as its main combat units. It also included mountain artillery, engineer, and transport regiments. The division’s call sign was River Division. In 1942, the 41st Division was first intended for Guadalcanal, but Japanese efforts to reinforce that island failed. The division was instead diverted to New Guinea. It arrived at Wewak in February 1943, where it joined the 18th Army. It fought through the New Guinea campaign against Australian and US forces. A detachment was sent to strengthen Lae and later took part in the Salamaua Lae campaign. By mid 1944, the 18th Army had been reduced mainly to the 41st Division. Its failed attack at the Driniumor River caused heavy losses. The survivors withdrew into the Prince Alexander Mountains, where disease and malnutrition caused further losses before Japan’s surrender in 1945.
